entry.name: AI Engineering in Python
entry.note: A project-based learning path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Career changers who want to learn by building projects

reading.cost: Subscription. The page does not state an amount.
covers: Python programming and developer tooling, including the command line, Git and virtual environments
Interfacing with large language models through APIs, prompt engineering and tool use
Building and deploying AI applications with FastAPI and Docker
Data analysis and visualization with pandas, NumPy and matplotlib
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning with scikit-learn
Embeddings, vector databases and semantic search
reading.format: An online learning path. Learners write code and get feedback directly in the browser, and work through guided projects based on realistic business scenarios.
reading.summary: AI Engineering in Python is a Dataquest learning path that runs from Python fundamentals through to deploying production AI systems. It covers working with LLMs through APIs and prompt engineering, then data analysis, machine learning, deep learning, embeddings, vector databases and RAG. Each step includes guided projects, so learners finish with a portfolio of AI applications. The page presents it as a route from zero to job-ready.
reading.audience: The page describes it as a career path that takes learners from zero to job-ready, for people who want the technical skills AI engineers need and who are preparing for interviews.
reading.prerequisites: None stated. The page says the path starts with Python fundamentals and takes learners from zero to job-ready.
